edits.anchor: and scurvy leaves the PT normal.
edits.html:
Class-vs-memberCryoprecipitate — it carries fibrinogen, factors VIII and XIII and von Willebrand factor. It lacks factors II, VII, IX and X, the factors vitamin K deficiency lowers.
Salient decoyFactor VIII concentrate — it treats hemophilia A; only plasma-derived concentrates that contain von Willebrand factor treat von Willebrand disease. Factor VIII does not need vitamin K, so it is not the missing factor here.
Unchecked attributePlatelets — vitamin K deficiency leaves the platelet count normal, so a platelet transfusion replaces nothing that is missing.
Sequencing trapLactated Ringer solution — it restores intravascular volume but carries no clotting factors. Replacing the factors with plasma treats the cause of the bleeding.
